title: Holomorphy of a Mellin tail with a measurable power-bounded coefficient
statement: Let R : ℝ → ℝ be Borel measurable, and let α, M : ℝ satisfy M ≥ 0 and |R(t)| ≤ Mt^α for every real t ≥ 1. For s ∈ ℂ let I(s) be the complex Lebesgue integral over (1,∞) of R(t)(t : ℂ)^(−(s+1)), using the principal complex power. Then the integrand is Bochner integrable on (1,∞) whenever α < Re(s), and I is complex differentiable on the open half-plane {s : α < Re(s)}. There is no sign restriction on α or R.
